adjudication.rationale: In apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts the handler early-returns when !APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED. That flag is defined as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, so reaching the decrypt line implies CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY is truthy/non-empty. Therefore `process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY || ""` is redundant/dead in normal execution, and keeping an empty-string fallback would be risky if the guard logic ever changes (it would attempt decrypt with an empty key rather than failing fast).
